Black Friday marketplace: daily challenge, 2026-12-26

The shared System Designer challenge for 2026-12-26: Black Friday marketplace. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

Once a year a marketplace puts thousands of deals live at the same minute. Millions browse and search, a few doorbuster items get hammered, and a smaller crowd checks out. A payment must never be taken twice, and the day must survive the card processor having a bad hour.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
